from pathlib import Path
import os,json,random,statistics,sys,time
ROOT=Path('/Users/lijie/source/goplus/wasmvm')
WORK=Path('/Users/lijie/source/goplus/wasmvm-source-cleanup')
OUT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(WORK/'benchmarks'))
import interleaved
os.environ['GOMAXPROCS']='1'
os.environ['GOGC']='100'
for key in ('WASMVM_COMPILE_PHASE','WASMVM_WARM_PROFILE','WASMVM_WARM_ALLOC_PROFILE','WASMVM_DIAGNOSTIC_JIT_MAP'):os.environ.pop(key,None)
count=500000000;seed=17;expected=(count+seed)&0xffffffff
variants={'base':ROOT/'artifacts/protocol-cost-20261112/loop-memory-stores/base-go-phase','go':OUT/'head-go-phase','llgo':OUT/'head-llgo-phase','wazero':OUT/'wazero-phase','wasmtime':ROOT/'artifacts/protocol-cost-20261112/loop-memory-stores/references/wasmtime-phase','wasmer':ROOT/'artifacts/protocol-cost-20261112/loop-memory-stores/references/wasmer-phase'}
commands={}
for name,binary in variants.items():
 cmd=[str(binary),'--backend','native'if name in ('base','go','llgo')else'compiler','--wasm',str(ROOT/'benchmarks/modern/threads-private-memory.wasm'),'--iterations',str(count),'--seed',str(seed),'--expected',str(expected),'--samples','7','--warmups','2']
 if name in ('base','go','llgo'):cmd+=['--mode','api']
 commands[name]=cmd;commands[name+'-aa']=cmd
plan=dict(blocks=20,samples=7,warmups=2,iterations=count,seed=seed,expected=expected,randomSeed=2026112707,commands=commands,scope='Separate fixed20-block/240-process event with 500M iterations per call, ten times the previous duration to investigate unresolved reference controls. Six runtimes with identical-binary A/A aliases; seven interleaved warm calls after first and two warmups; every result checked. Original private stores, all mandatory cancellation polls, quotas and full public native API retained. Source head09d898ba versus b01fc29 tree-equivalent base4d41a12. Pinned Go1.27.3 and LLGo3d92a58 -O3 -lto=full; LLGo main upgrade is not mixed here. Wazero1.12.0, Wasmtime48.0.1, Wasmer7.3.0. GOMAXPROCS1, GOGC100. Startup/compile/instantiate/cleanup separate. No other owned builds/tests/profiles/pruning overlap. A/A resolution predeclared within2.5percent; unresolved controls remain unresolved. Earlier cohorts retained separately, no pooling or repeated-look acceptance; no full-portfolio milestone claim.')
assert not(OUT/'rows.jsonl').exists()
(OUT/'plan.json').write_text(json.dumps(plan,indent=2)+'\n')
rng=random.Random(plan['randomSeed']);rows=[]
for block in range(plan['blocks']):
 observations,orders=interleaved.invoke(commands,120,rng,samples=7)
 for name,ob in observations.items():
  record=ob['record'];assert record['warmResults']==[expected]*7 and record['warmupResults']==[expected]*2 and record['result']==expected
  assert record['iterations']==count and record['seed']==seed
  row=dict(block=block,id=name,observation=ob,orders=orders,nsPerIteration=statistics.median(record['warmCallNs'])/count)
  with(OUT/'rows.jsonl').open('a')as f:f.write(json.dumps(row)+'\n')
  rows.append(row)
 print(block,{name:round(statistics.median(r['nsPerIteration']for r in rows if r['block']==block and r['id']==name),5)for name in commands},flush=True)
summary={name:statistics.median(r['nsPerIteration']for r in rows if r['id']==name)for name in commands}
(OUT/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(plan=plan,summary=summary),indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(summary),flush=True)
